summary: First-run E2E testing for Anclora CleanSheet MVP. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases passed against public URL (status, auth, sample ERP, analyze, preview recalc, xlsx/csv export, recipes CRUD, compatibility, upload). Frontend: Playwright verified page load, ES/EN toggle, theme dark/light toggle, sample ERP load with heuristic analysis (17 changes badge, analysis summary visible), rule editing (skip_rows) with debounced recalc, YAML modal + Python-with-pandas modal, XLSX and CSV downloads, login with demo credentials, save recipe to account, and Recipes tab listing the saved recipe. All core functional flows work end-to-end.

minor.issue: CORSMiddleware configured with allow_origins=['*'] AND allow_credentials=True. This combination is rejected by browsers per spec and will break auth cookies when frontend is served from a different origin than the API. Currently works because preview URL routes /api on the same origin. Explicit origins list should be used with credentials.
Manually calls next(get_db()) without closing the session (leaks a SQLAlchemy session per sample request). Use Depends(get_db) for consistency.
Leftover MONGO_URL / DB_NAME variables from template though project uses SQLAlchemy/SQLite. Harmless but misleading.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking a non-changed normalized cell does not display the cell-change-audit-box (data-testid=cell-change-audit-box). This may be intended (only changed cells reveal audit) but there is no user hint that clicks are only meaningful on highlighted/changed cells. Consider showing the audit box on any click with an 'unchanged cell' message.

action_items: Tighten CORS: replace allow_origins=['*'] with explicit list (frontend origin) since allow_credentials=True is set — required for future cross-origin deployments.
In /api/samples/{sample_type} use Depends(get_db) instead of next(get_db()) to prevent session leaks.
Optional UX: guide users to click changed (highlighted) cells for the audit panel, or always show the audit panel with 'no change' state.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py CORS: '*' + allow_credentials=True is spec-invalid; will fail on cross-origin browsers.
server.py get_sample_data manually invokes next(get_db()) without closing — session leak.
backend/.env still contains unused MONGO_URL/DB_NAME — clean up to avoid confusion.
server.py FILE_CACHE is in-memory (dict); ok for MVP but will break in multi-worker deployments and grows unbounded — add TTL/cleanup or move to Redis for production.
Auth uses long-lived JWT_SECRET default embedded in code; ensure env override is enforced in production.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (14/14) — cell audit shown only for changed cells is arguably a UX gap, not a failure

seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up a temporary user via /api/auth/register (test_user_<random>@example.com) and a TEST_UI_Recipe saved from the UI; both cleaned up post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All primary flows green on preview URL. Priority follow-ups are CORS hardening and session-leak fix in /api/samples. When retesting, verify cell-change-audit-box visibility on a clearly changed cell (e.g., a European-decimal amount like '1.250,50' -> '1250.50') by clicking that highlighted cell in table-normalized-container.
